title: OntologyConceptQuery
description: SQL generated from a native concept's table bindings, optionally following search-around hops. The request sends only hops; the response returns them with their labels and the generated SQL. OpenMetadata generates the SQL and never runs it (ADR:2026-10-21-ontology-live-data-execution-is-a-collate-extension).

hop.description: One step from the previous concept to a related concept through an object property.

property.description: Id of the OBJECT property that relates the previous concept and the target.

target.description: Id of the concept this hop reaches.

label.description: Relation label written as the JOIN comment. Set by the server.

direction.description: Which way the hop follows its property, as the Studio's chip shows it. `outgoing` follows the property from its subject to its object, and `incoming` follows it back from its object to its subject.

dialect.description: Identifier quoting family of the bound table's service.

hops.description: Search-around hops in order, at most five.

sql.description: Generated SELECT with LIMIT 50. Set by the server.

service.description: Name of the database service that holds the bound tables. Set by the server.

serviceType.description: Type of that database service. Set by the server.

tables.description: Fully qualified names of the tables the SQL reads, in join order. Set by the server.
